name: Kaushik Reddy Awala
greeting: Hi there, I'm Awala, Kaushik Reddy! 👋
title: Software Engineer
bio: I'm a full-stack web developer focused on responsive and accessible design. Passionate about efficiency, optimization, and working in a culture of "Purpose" to change the world.
I specialize in frontend frameworks like Angular, Vue.js, and React, paired with .NET Core backends and cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS.
Beyond coding, I'm fascinated by quantum computing and blockchain technology. I'm a regional table tennis tournament winner, an aspiring poet working on a book, and an experimental cook.
